items.title: SL1 US  Leading Operations Pre-Shift:  Utilizes data and insights to plan and lead effective shifts; set priorities and follow up on items needing action.
SL1-US-1 Leading Operations During Shift (Travel Paths): Shift Leader conducts  travel paths, sets priorities, and takes appropriate action throughout the  shift.
SL1-US-2 Leading Operations During Shift (Danger Zones): Shift Leader observes  and proactively identifies potential danger zones and takes effective action.  Observe throughout the shift.

SL2-US Leading Operations During Shift (Production): Shift Leader works with Area Leaders to 
coach employees to ensure quality, achieve targets, identify danger zones, prioritize & 
reduce operational barriers to deliver Gold Standard products, and support a great 
customer experience

SL3- US  Leading Operations During Shift (Service): Shift Leader works with Area Leaders to coach employees to ensure quality, achieve targets, identify danger zones, and prioritize & reduce operational barriers to deliver great customer service across all service channels.

SL4 - US  Leading Operations Post Shift: Shift Leader reflects on how well the  restaurant delivered on the shift management results and recognizes and  rewards employees for meeting shift targets and performance excellence.
SL5 - US  Customer Experience: All managers role model hospitality and look for ways to enhance the customer experience.
SL8- US  Customer Feedback: Restaurant has a CSAT/recovery system utilizing  customer feedback to develop a restaurant action plan to address  customer service.
SL7-US  Resources: Shift Leader accesses and analyzes relevant data, makes  effective decisions, and utilizes resources to ensure operational excellence  on the shift.

SL9- US  Internal Operations Communication: Are channels for communicating  operations-related information established, used, and employees aware of  and actively supporting the restaurant operations priorities?
SL11- US  People Positioning: Are employees positioned and adjustments made, as  conditions dictate, throughout the shift?
